# Filter rows where Year is 2012
df_2012 = df[df['Year'] == 2012]

# Convert 'Box Office' column to numeric by removing '$' and ' billion', then convert to float
df_2012['Box Office Numeric'] = df_2012['Box Office'].str.replace('$', '').str.replace(' billion', '').astype(float)

# Find the row with the minimum box office value
min_row = df_2012.loc[df_2012['Box Office Numeric'].idxmin()]

# Extract the country name
answer = min_row['Country']
